title: What happens if you stay awake for 3 days? Day 1

beats.text: What happens to your body if you stay awake for three days straight? Hoot's finding out, so you don't have to. Day one.
Hour 17. Your brain is already as slow as someone who's been drinking.
By hour 24, it's like being legally drunk. Your reactions slow down, your memory slips, and you get cranky.
Inside, your body panics a little. It pumps out stress hormones, cortisol and adrenaline, just to keep you going.
And you get hungrier. Your hunger hormone goes up, so you start craving snacks.
But that's just day one. On day two, your brain starts switching off, without asking you.
Have you ever pulled an all-nighter? Tell me below, and follow Hoot for day two.
